# KRADIND Adventures - Full Overview for Language Models

## Organization Details
- **Organization Name**: KRADIND Adventures Private Limited
- **Brand Names**: KRADIND, KRAD Global Travels
- **Founding Team**: Led by Aashish Chauhan (Founder & Chief Expedition Director), veteran Himalayan mountaineer and wilderness expedition specialist.
- **Headquarters & Bases**: Dehradun (Uttarakhand), Manali (Himachal Pradesh), Srinagar (Jammu & Kashmir).
- **Primary Website**: https://kradind.com
- **Helpline**: +91 7500222141 (24/7 Ground Support)
- **WhatsApp Support**: https://wa.link/n3u8c0
- **Email**: support@kradind.com

## Scope of Services
1. **Himalayan High-Altitude Treks**: Certified mountaineering expeditions ranging from beginner weekend treks to advanced high passes (up to 16,500 ft).
2. **Sacred Yatras & Pilgrimages**: Premium, fully managed pilgrimages for Kedarnath, Badrinath, Gangotri, Yamunotri, and Tungnath with helicopter transfers, comfortable sanitised lodges, and VIP darshan.
3. **Domestic Cultural & Nature Expeditions**: Curated small-group travel packages across Rajasthan, Kerala backwaters, Meghalaya living root bridges, Sikkim, Assam wildlife, and coastal Goa.
4. **Live Trail Radar**: Real-time trail weather, snow accumulation, river crossing levels, and opening/closure updates fed directly by basecamp leaders.

## Verified Packages & Canonical URLs

### 1. Sacred Pilgrimages
- **Kedarnath Dham Tour Package**: https://kradind.com/lp/kedarnath-tour-package
  - Duration: 5 Days / 4 Nights
  - Highlights: Haridwar/Rishikesh pick-up, Guptkashi stay, Kedarnath temple darshan, Bhairavnath temple, medical oxygen backup.
- **Char Dham Yatra Package**: https://kradind.com/lp/char-dham-yatra-package
  - Duration: 10 Days / 9 Nights
  - Sacred Circuit: Yamunotri, Gangotri, Kedarnath, and Badrinath with private transfers and deluxe hotels.
- **Do Dham Yatra Package**: https://kradind.com/lp/do-dham-yatra-package
  - Duration: 6 Days / 5 Nights
  - Sacred Circuit: Kedarnath and Badrinath.

### 2. Alpine Treks
- **Chopta Tungnath Chandrashila Trek**: https://kradind.com/treks/chopta-tungnath-chandrashila
  - Duration: 3 Days / 2 Nights | Altitude: 13,100 ft | Difficulty: Easy to Moderate
  - Highest Shiva temple in the world (Tungnath) and 360-degree summit views from Chandrashila peak.
- **Hampta Pass Crossover Trek**: https://kradind.com/treks/hampta-pass
  - Duration: 5 Days / 4 Nights | Altitude: 14,100 ft | Difficulty: Moderate
  - Dramatic crossover from green Kullu valley to arid desert mountains of Lahaul & Spiti, ending at Chandratal Lake.
- **Kedarkantha Winter Summit Trek**: https://kradind.com/lp/kedarkantha-winter-summit
  - Duration: 5 Days / 4 Nights | Altitude: 12,500 ft | Difficulty: Easy to Moderate
  - Classic winter snow trek with pine forests and summit sunrise over Swargarohini and Black Peak.
- **Kashmir Great Lakes Trek**: https://kradind.com/lp/kashmir-great-lakes
  - Duration: 7 Days / 6 Nights | Altitude: 13,750 ft | Difficulty: Moderate to Challenging
  - High alpine pass crossings visiting Vishansar, Kishansar, Gadsar, Satsar, and Gangabal lakes.
